import re

# Use the already-loaded csv_content, handle \r\n line endings
data_lines = csv_content.strip().replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').split('\n')
header_cols = data_lines[0].split(',')
print(f"Columns: {header_cols}")

# Find column indices
amount_idx = header_cols.index('amount')
status_idx = header_cols.index('status')
deal_id_idx = header_cols.index('deal_id')
rep_idx = header_cols.index('rep_name')
product_idx = header_cols.index('product')

won_deals = []
won_total = 0.0

for row_line in data_lines[1:]:
    if not row_line.strip():
        continue
    fields = row_line.split(',')
    status = fields[status_idx].strip().lower()
    if status == 'won':
        amt = float(fields[amount_idx].strip())
        won_deals.append({
            'deal_id': fields[deal_id_idx].strip(),
            'rep': fields[rep_idx].strip(),
            'product': fields[product_idx].strip(),
            'amount': amt
        })
        won_total += amt

print(f"\nMeridian Analytics — Won Deals in Q3 ({len(won_deals)} deals):")
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep':<20} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>12}")
print("-" * 70)
for d in won_deals:
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['rep']:<20} {d['product']:<25} ${d['amount']:>11,.2f}")
print("-" * 70)
print(f"{'TOTAL':<55} ${won_total:>11,.2f}")
